title: Olivine Clover
body:
The Olivine Clover was formerly a limited time tree that only spawned during the Saint Patrick's Day event. However, it now is permanently obtainable, though, in scarcer quantity except during the event. The clover is a massive four-leaf clover that only spawns in the Flowering Meadows.

Description

The Olivine Clover was added as part of the Saint Patrick's Day event alongside the Gold Coin and many other items. This tree requires a Rusty Axe or above to chop. It is a lighter green than the Ferwater Clover.

Trivia

  • As of v1.5.4(04/14/23), the tree was brought back to permanently stay in the game.
